_note: Frank's approach lines (plan section 6.1, K3). The progress bar and the growth n/3 readout were removed from every gate display; these four one-shot messages are what replaced them. Each speaks at most once per run (latch.one_shot is spent at admission, so an MRR dip and re-cross never brings it back) and carries no number. The step comes from phase.series_a_approach, which counts PhaseGateSystem.APPROACH_PCTS marks cleared against the gate's own finance.mrr leaf; the bar is never in this file. This one: the third mark (about nine tenths). Step 4 is the bar itself, which belongs to the door-open line.
